purpose: Define a package-manager-style command surface for creating, installing, running, updating, and upgrading CAST workflow candidates.

verbs.name: create
verbs.purpose: Scaffold a named CAST workflow candidate from a declared template.
verbs.effects: Writes only to an isolated candidate workspace and records its manifest and sourceRef.
gates: Show created paths and next commands
verbs.authority: Creates a candidate only; does not install, run, publish, deploy, dispatch CAST, or grant approval.

verbs.name: install
verbs.purpose: Resolve and install declared candidate dependencies.
verbs.effects: Uses an isolated workspace and lockfile with exact versions and integrity hashes; runs no dependency lifecycle scripts by default.
gates: Enforce declared registries and dependency policy
Stop on unpinned or integrity-mismatched artifacts
verbs.authority: Dependency installation only; does not install a ChatGPT plugin into the host or prove current-chat CAST completion.

verbs.name: run
verbs.purpose: Run a named script declared in the candidate manifest.
verbs.effects: Binds execution to an exact sourceRef and bounded task scope; captures command, logs, exit status, and artifact hashes.
gates: Use the selected escalation audit depth
Stop on source drift or failed checks
verbs.authority: Runs the declared candidate workflow only; cannot merge, publish, deploy, create an approval, or dispatch final CAST.

verbs.name: update
verbs.purpose: Refresh dependencies within their already declared compatibility ranges.
verbs.effects: Updates the isolated candidate lockfile and produces a reviewable diff.
gates: Run affected checks before reporting ready
verbs.authority: Candidate update only; does not mutate a canonical or active runtime or dispatch final CAST.

verbs.name: upgrade
verbs.purpose: Plan an explicit version-range or major-version migration.
verbs.effects: Produces a migration plan and diff in the isolated candidate workspace before applying candidate changes.
gates: Show breaking changes and rollback plan
verbs.authority: Candidate migration only; does not mutate a canonical or active runtime or dispatch final CAST.

globalOptions.behavior: Show read-only help for the namespace or selected verb; may appear before or after a verb.
Bind mutating or executing candidate work to an exact source identity; required by run.
Print the planned actions and writes without applying them.
Emit machine-readable output without changing command effects or authority.

unknownVerb.behavior: Return canonical help and suggestions; execute nothing.

lifecycle.shellExecution: Only a declared, reviewed manifest script may execute; no implicit scripts.

authorityBoundary.dispatchContract: Only the separately defined owner-authored GitHub `/cast <milestone> <40-char-current-main-sha>` trigger may dispatch its gated milestone; `CAST`, `castBridge`, and every local CLI verb remain non-dispatching.
